name: @blobatar/svelte
description: Svelte adapter for blobatar — deterministic geometric avatars.

scripts.//build: None. There is nothing to build: the published artifact is the source, and a `dist` would only be a copy of it. This package is the reason `packages/harness` measures a source-resolved adapter by what it ships rather than by a `dist` it does not have.

author: Alain
//exports: Source-resolved: what ships is Svelte, not JavaScript. A Svelte component only becomes renderable code inside the consumer's own compiler, so there is no built entry for a `default` condition to point at — and none is invented. A resolver without the `svelte` condition gets a resolution error naming this package, which is the true answer, rather than a file it cannot execute. See ADR-0010.
//peerDependencies: `blobatar` is pinned to an exact major, not `^2`. Every package in this set publishes the same version (`.changeset/config.json`), and npm does not enforce that at install time — under ADR-0008 the major names the generation, so a mixed pair is not a version skew, it is the wrong picture. `packages/harness` asserts this range.
